hero.statement: Patient-centred dentistry, built on more than five years of hands-on clinical experience, careful professionalism and a steady commitment to keep learning.

about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I care as much about how a patient feels in the chair as I do about how the treatment turns out. Over more than five years I have looked after patients of all ages, across general, restorative, aesthetic and oral surgery dentistry.
Along the way I have led a dental team, worked alongside orthodontists, and learned that a clear conversation about options and aftercare is what builds the trust good care depends on.

In 2026 I completed my Licence in Dental Surgery with the Royal College of Surgeons of England and began observational placements in the UK, sharpening the way I communicate with patients here. I practise ethically, and I never stop learning.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.intro: From foundation rotations to leading a dental team.

highlights: Developed communication skills with UK patients
Gained exposure to a variety of dental programmes and techniques
Worked with Exact and other dental software and techniques
Careful screening of teeth and soft tissues, with diagnostic imaging to shape precise treatment plans
Extractions, restorative care and prosthodontic solutions, including crowns and bridges
Cosmetic work including veneers and teeth whitening
Gum disease assessment and treatment, and emergency dental care at short notice
Strict infection control, confidential patient records and close collaboration with staff on quality standards
Root canal treatment and corrective surgery for impacted or misaligned teeth, with clear discussion of treatment plans and aftercare
Prosthodontic planning including dentures, crowns, bridges and veneers
Paediatric care for early childhood caries: pulpotomies, pulpectomies, stainless steel crowns and preventive care
Teeth whitening and periodontal prevention and treatment planning
Planning of simple orthodontic cases
Painless dental procedures and emergency care, with patient comfort first
Diagnosis of oral conditions to support the early detection of serious disease
Periodontal treatment, extractions and restorative work
Crowns, bridges, dentures and root canal treatment
Led a dental team and collaborated with orthodontists during braces and complex procedures
Oral and maxillofacial surgery
Prosthodontics and paedodontics
Conservative and restorative dentistry
Periodontology and dental public health
